reasons: UNSUPPORTED: "Le 3 janvier 2024, à 16 ans, finale perdue 7 à 4 contre Humphries; 200 000 livres" (7-4 Humphries, age 16 and GBP 200,000 are confirmed. The date 3 January 2024 does not appear in the fetched NBC report. Cite a source that gives the date or drop it.)

UNSUPPORTED: "La DH rappelle qu'il est devenu le plus jeune champion du monde de l'histoire, à 17 ans, en dépassant le record de van Gerwen établi en 2014 à 24 ans" (La DH's report of the final does not carry the youngest-champion claim as fetched. Sky's 2025 final page does say youngest ever PDC champion. The 2014 van Gerwen mark in the Sky Grand Slam page is the youngest PDC world No 1 record (24y 251d), not a youngest champion record. Attribute the youngest claim to Sky (sky-sports-world-championship-2025-final) and drop the record-breaking framing.)

UNSUPPORTED: "L'écart s'explique par la date : le chiffre de Sky précède les titres de 2026" (Causal explanation. The cited Sky 2026 page does not discuss the major count. Dates alone show only that the figures are from Nov 2025 and Oct 2026. State the dates and drop the causal claim.)

Reviewer recommends rejection: Most claims check out. Three need fixing: an unsupported date (3 January 2024 for the 2024 final), a record framing attributed to La DH that the source does not support (youngest champion versus van Gerwen's 2014 No 1 record), and a causal explanation for the 8 vs 13 major gap. Citation tags also sit in the summary and FAQ frontmatter.
